mapper.select: select u.id, u.username, u.password as encodedPassword, u.real_name as realName, r.role_code as roleCode, r.role_name as roleName, u.status, u.department, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar_url as avatarUrl, u.permissions from sys_user u left join user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.id left join role r on r.id = ur.role_id where u.username = #{username}
